sourceEvidence.title: Director of Operations & Manufacturing
sourceEvidence.quote:
### **Preferred**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Industrial Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* Lean Six Sigma certification (Black Belt or Green Belt)
* Experience in the metal building / pre-engineered building industry
* Familiarity with AISC certification and/or IAS AC472
* ERP-driven manufacturing experience (NetSuite a plus)
* Experience in a private equity-backed or high-growth environment
